results.name: A1 install: 0004 applied in order from the migrations directory; 0001 untouched (sha pinned in phase2d)
A2 ACL: exactly the 15 of 0004 gained authenticated; anon/PUBLIC/server roles none; 23 closed functions still closed; anon catalog = 12
A3 season fix: update_draft_fixture body = COMPETITION-V1 (baseline + season access), definer + pinned search_path
A3b guard-order fix: publish_tournament_document_version authorizes before its idempotent answer (body = COMPETITION-V1)
A4 migration: re-apply is a no-op (idempotent); a state without 0001 is refused before any change
A5 rollback: the documented rollback returns exactly the 0001 ACL of the 15 (in a rolled-back transaction), then 0004 is intact
A6 gateway: allowlists loaded — staging v1 unchanged (43), competition (74) disjoint, public (1) disjoint; contract.json = allowlist
B1 organization / seasons / tournaments / categories + collaborators and season seats (gateway, real Core sessions)
B2 league tournament A (season A) and B (season B): 4 approved teams in A (captains accepted through the Core contract, one Arma2 player), 1 team in B
B3 fixture: freeze participants (idempotent replay) → generate league (idempotent replay) → validate → publish; tournament scheduled
B4 lifecycle start (admin, idempotent); reopen needs the owner capability (admin denied)
B5 venues, courts, schedule windows, schedule validation, schedule + auto-schedule + reschedule
B6 availability (rostered player) + squads saved and submitted by each captain; a captain cannot touch the rival squad
B7 match report (acta): open → outcome → score 2-1 → goal events → incident voided → submitted by the admin
B8 review (owner) → dual control (submitter cannot validate) → validate (owner) → official twice concurrently (idempotent, one official)
B9 standings: rebuild (idempotent key) → context shows 3/0 → publish revision → the participant reads the published table
B10 correction: request (admin) → concurrent create (one version) → score 1-1 (goal voided) → submit/review/validate/official → rebuild → table updated 1/1
B11 statistics / scorers: official statistics after the correction (1 goal each side, voided goal gone); published statistics for participants
B12 participant hub: hub, category preference, published matches / match / teams (player and captain)
B13 communications + notifications: draft → audience → link → preview → publish; inbox, read, document publish + acknowledge; preferences
B14 public page: unpublished → null on the public route; admin publishes → anon reads the page with the official table; no private data
B15 lifecycle on a 2-team tournament: play the single match officially → finish (admin) → reopen denied to admin → reopen by owner
B16 withdrawal: collaborator / captain denied; admin withdraws a team from tournament A; participant marked withdrawn
B17 groups: freeze → reopen participants → freeze again → save pots → group draw published → group fixture generated/published
B18 qualification: group matches official → group tables resolved; league C table → playoffs appended → qualification fills the final (cross-season admin refused)
C1 every allowlisted RPC was exercised by the journey (or is certified at the guard level with the reason recorded)
C2 negative matrix: outsider (other workspace), unassigned-season admin, removed membership, captain/player on staff RPCs, collaborator on staff writes → 403 42501, no state change
C3 no bearer → 401 at the gateway for every allowlisted RPC (before PostgREST)
C4 anon straight at PostgREST: every newly granted function is refused by the DB ACL; closed functions refused for authenticated too
D1 RPCs outside the contract are refused by the gateway even with a valid session (service-only, OFF features)
D2 public route: credentials refused, only the listed RPC, POST + JSON only, exact arguments, size limit
D3 invalid IDs: unknown organization / match / operation → 403 42501; malformed UUID → 400; wrong-organization pairing → 403
D4 bearer lifecycle: expired bridge → 401; re-exchange → 200; forged session id → 401; Core logout → exchange and RPC 401
D5 Core unavailable → 503 fail closed (no stale success); Torneos REST unavailable → 503; both recover
D6 persistence: after new exchanges and a gateway restart the table, report and public page read back identically
D7 table routes: a bearer cannot write competition tables directly (RLS: no client write policy); reads stay RLS-scoped
D8 no-store: every gateway response of this run (RPC, public, errors) carried Cache-Control: no-store
